maddeler.e:
أتصالح (form VI)
# أَتَصَالَحُ (ʔataṣālaḥu) /ʔa.ta.sˤaː.la.ħu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَصَالَحَ (taṣālaḥa)
# أَتَصَالَحَ (ʔataṣālaḥa) /ʔa.ta.sˤaː.la.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَصَالَحَ (taṣālaḥa)
# أَتَصَالَحْ (ʔataṣālaḥ) /ʔa.ta.sˤaː.laħ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَصَالَحَ (taṣālaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
